templates.name: comfyfed-wuxia-t2i
templates.title: 武俠文生圖 / Wuxia text-to-image
templates.description: Flux text-to-image, 768x768 at 8 steps. The graph ComfyFed's first end-to-end federation run used; edit the prompt and press Run.

templates.name: comfyfed-character-portrait
templates.title: 角色立繪 / Character portrait
templates.description: Flux character reference sheet, 896x1152 at 20 steps. Feed its output into the reference-to-video template.

templates.name: comfyfed-ref2v-video
templates.title: 參考圖生影片 / Reference to video
templates.description: MiniMax H3 reference-to-video with audio, 1152x640, 141 frames at 8 steps via the turbo LoRA. Ships with a reference image.

templates.name: comfyfed-video-concat
templates.title: 多影片串接 / Video concat
templates.description: Join two video clips end-to-end, picture and audio both concatenated. Needs zero models -- runs on a brand-new worker.

templates.name: comfyfed-image-intro-video
templates.title: 圖片開場＋影片 / Image intro + video
templates.description: Hold one still image for a few seconds as a title card, then play a video clip. Needs zero models -- runs on a brand-new worker.

templates.name: comfyfed-image-to-prompt
templates.title: 圖生提示詞 / Image to prompt
templates.description: Upload a reference image and a short ask; a local Qwen3-VL model writes the polished English prompt for you. Ships with a sample image.

templates.name: comfyfed-text-to-prompt
templates.title: 文字生提示詞 / Text to prompt
templates.description: Paste a rough idea and the same local Qwen3-VL model rewrites it into a structured English prompt.

templates.name: comfyfed-flf2v-video
templates.title: 首尾幀生影片 / First+last frame to video
templates.description: Give MiniMax H3 a first frame and a last frame plus a one-sentence action description; it generates the motion (and audio) in between.

templates.name: comfyfed-video-trim
templates.title: 影片截段 / Video trim
templates.description: Cut a start-second + length span out of a video clip. Needs zero models -- runs on a brand-new worker.

templates.name: comfyfed-image-upscale
templates.title: 圖片放大 / Image upscale
templates.description: 4x super-resolution upscale of a still image via RealESRGAN. Ships with a sample image.
